newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria 1996 trade deficit widens 14.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Austria 1996 trade deficit widens 14.3 pct.

text.p: Austria's trade deficit widened 12.553 billion schillings, or 14.3 percent, to 100.57 billion schillings in 1996, according to final data released by state statistics office OeSTAT on Wednesday.
Imports rose 6.7 percent, or 44.7 billion schillings, to 712.76 billion schillings, while exports climbed 5.5 percent, or 32.2 billion, to to 612.19 billion schillings.
A 112.1 billion schilling trade deficit with fellow European Union members was partly offset by a 11.545 billion schilling trade surplus with non-EU nations.
